surfaces.scope: whole History surface; see the separately scoped table DOM contract
unresolved_evidence_gaps: The current live captures prove the seven-cell AMC fragment only; they do not capture source-side mobile CSS, focus/hover states, pagination transitions, or action outcomes.

The AMC fragment contains .odate markup and date text, but it does not prove final client-side date hydration. Wikijump's retained Wikidot Base CSS hides .odate with display:none, so visible/relative date behavior remains unverified and quarantined.
Live History includes an F file/attachment operation row. Wikijump's page revision API does not expose a combined page/file timeline, so that row remains an explicit source/runtime gap.
Current capture requests only the first ten rows; paging and longer-history behavior are not proven.

surfaces.scope: combined page History timeline rows for file/attachment operations carrying the observed F flag
unresolved_evidence_gaps: Wikidot returns a file/attachment operation row in the shared page History module. Wikijump pageHistory reads page revisions only; file revisions are exposed separately and do not currently contribute a row to this combined timeline. The confirmed mismatch remains quarantined pending an explicit implementation decision and file-revision parity contract.

surfaces.scope: only the observed History table DOM contract: seven ordered cells, row id prefix, from/to radios, flag/action cells, author/date/comment selectors; localization may change visible header/flag text
intentional_differences: Header labels and flag tooltip text are localized while cell order and selectors remain stable.
unresolved_evidence_gaps: This narrow DOM certification does not establish date hydration/visibility, mobile styling, interaction outcomes, pager states, or combined file revision rows.
